programme.name: National Certificate Vocational: Office Administration Level 2-4
programme.description: A programme at each of Levels 2, 3 and 4 of the NQF covering the theory and practice of Office Administration.

notes: A candidate may only register two consecutive levels in an academic year.
Prospective students must complete a placement questionnaire.

CS Barlow and CN Phatudi campuses: Level 2 Business Studies requires a passed Grade 11 report and Level 2 Engineering Studies a Grade 11 report with Mathematics; Level 3 requires passing Level 2 with at least 5 subjects; Level 4 requires passing Level 2 in all 7 subjects and Level 3 with at least 5 subjects.

programme.name: National N Diploma: Financial Management N4-N6

notes: N4 entry requires a National Senior Certificate; N5 requires N4 or an equivalent qualification; N6 requires N5 or an equivalent qualification.
New students must enrol for all four subjects in the particular field.
Students must complete the required working hours before a National N Diploma is issued: 18 months / 2000 hours for semester programmes and 24 months / 2670 hours for trimester programmes.
Course duration is a semester per level at CS Barlow Campus (January-June, July-November) and a trimester per level at CN Phatudi Campus (January-April, May-August, September-November).
Also available as distance education.
